verdict.rationale: The Edison/FutureHouse Python client covers the main platform workflows programmatically. You can submit tasks for every agent type via the JobNames enum, run batch tasks and retrieve results later, upload data, fetch notebooks and artifacts, and hold long-lived chat sessions. However, the docs never claim the API matches the UI, API tokens must be created in the web UI's profile page, and no public OpenAPI spec exists (all probes returned 404). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API-based token and account management, a published OpenAPI/REST spec, and independent confirmation that UI-only features (e.g., figure pullouts, plan management) are reachable via the API.
